evidence.head_shape: All six figures' faces read as round near-circles under their hair volume (side-part, afro, bun x2, curly-top, bald-with-side-hair), consistent with base.png's round head doctrine.
evidence.no_nose_no_ears: FAIL, new regression not present in the round-1 image: verified via 4x close-up crops of all six faces, EVERY figure has a clearly drawn ear -- a distinct skin-toned rounded lobe shape with its own outline separate from the hair, including an inner helix/tragus line, positioned at cheek/jaw level below the hairline (figure 1 left cheek, figure 2 left cheek under curls, figure 3 left cheek under curls, figure 4 right cheek -- faces the opposite way from the rest, figure 5 right cheek under curls, figure 6 right cheek below the bun). This is the same doctrine the base rig (refs/base/base.png) deliberately omits -- base.png's bald head shows smooth skin with no ear bump drawn at all. No nose is drawn on any of the six (flat skin between eyes and mouth on all), so the failure here is ears only, but it is a clean, unambiguous, all-six-figures failure.
evidence.four_digit_hands: Checked crops of both hanging hands on figures 1, 3 and 6 (representative sample across skin tones/garments): each shows the simplified stylized mitt with finger-separation lines reading as three to four fingers plus thumb, consistent with the base rig hand family; no five-digit realistic hand on any figure.
evidence.proportion: QUANTITATIVE MEASUREMENT (figure pixel height / head pixel width, via a throwaway PIL script segmenting the 6 figures by background-column gaps, then measuring each figure's non-background bounding-box height and each head's max row-width above its neck-narrowing point; cross-checked visually with gridline overlays at 1.0x/1.5x/2.0x head-width above the feet): figure 1 (leftmost, brown side-part) height=527px headW=157px ratio=3.36; figure 2 (curly-afro, gray sweater+skirt) height=534px headW=170px ratio=3.14; figure 3 (dark curly-top, green shirt) height=529px headW=165px ratio=3.21; figure 4 (blond, orange polo) height=525px headW=156px ratio=3.37; figure 5 (curly-brown, red cardigan+skirt) height=534px headW=173px ratio=3.09; figure 6 (rightmost, bun, light-blue shirt) height=536px headW=161px ratio=3.33. Total-height/head-width uniformity: range 525-536px, diff=11px, well under half a head-width (~80px) -- the round-1 spread problem (3.26-3.91) is fixed and all six now nominally land inside the numeric 3.0-3.5 band. HOWEVER this headline ratio is misleading and does not reflect the retry's actual demand: the retry explicitly required 'visible leg length under ONE head-width' and 'short, stubby legs,' and the ratio metric's denominator (head width) is inflated by voluminous hair (afro/bun/curls), which lowers the ratio without the body actually being squat/chibi. Calibrating the same gridline method against base.png (the squat reference) shows base.png's own leg -- hip/hoodie-hem to floor -- sits entirely within 1.0 head-width (the 1x line lands right at the hoodie hem). Applying identical 1.0x/1.5x/2.0x head-width gridlines to all six candidate figures (verified directly on figures 1, 2, 4 and 5, with figures 3 and 6 sharing the same body/leg construction on visual inspection) shows the 1.0x line lands only at mid-thigh in every case, while the 1.5x line lands right at the waist/hip -- i.e. the true leg span (hip to floor, whether under trousers or exposed below a skirt hem) is consistently ~1.5x a head-width across all six figures, roughly 50% over the retry's explicit ceiling. Every figure reads as a normally-proportioned adult body with a moderately large head, not the compact chibi/squat build of base.png. Ruling FAIL: round 2 traded round 1's uneven-spread failure for a new, uniform failure -- all six figures are now consistently too leggy rather than variably too leggy, and the retry's core stated goal (squat build, stubby sub-head-width legs matching the base rig) is not met by any of the six.
evidence.flat_cel_render: Flat single-colour fills across all six figures' skin tones and clothing (vests, sweaters, cardigans, polos, shirts, skirts, trousers) with only simple two-tone cel shading (one light panel, one shadow panel); no gradient/airbrush blending and no weave/mottled/noise texture on any garment, viewed both in full-body crops and close hand/leg crops.
evidence.outline_consistency: Even medium-thick dark outline is held across all six figures at their smaller on-canvas scale -- heads, hair, garments, hands and shoes all carry continuous outline with no thin or missing segments, matching the weight seen on base.png.
evidence.crowd_face_simplification: FAIL for the same reason as no_nose_no_ears: the demanded checklist for this axis explicitly includes 'NO ears,' and every one of the six figures has a clearly drawn ear (see no_nose_no_ears evidence). The other sub-criteria all pass -- every figure has plain dot eyes, one simple neutral closed mouth line, no nose, no teeth, no eyebrows, and no figure is more individuated than another (the ear is present uniformly on all six, not singling one figure out) -- but 'no individuated features' does not waive the explicit 'no ears' requirement, so the axis is ruled FAIL.
